tasks.short: Order maintenance parts, supplies and equipment from suppliers.

steps.what: Verify the equipment need and capture exact part specifications and purchasing constraints
inputs: actual maintenance need and equipment identification
current manuals and approved purchasing limits

steps.what: Find compatible catalogue lines using exact checked part numbers and specifications
inputs: current actual supplier catalogue and offers

steps.what: Populate the draft order with selected exact supplier lines and quantities
Select and approve the final priced order, compatibility, terms and supplier
Send the approved final maintenance order to the supplier
Check actual supplier acceptance, price changes and promised delivery
Write and approve the actual order status and confirmation reference
outputs: approved actual maintenance order status record

steps.what: Commit the approved actual maintenance order status record
inputs: approved actual maintenance order status record

tasks.design: Use native catalogue filters and order forms in {PROCUREMENT}, with the existing maintenance record system ({OTHER}). Keep original requirements capture, compatibility and final order judgement human. The final priced order is approved before its separate supplier send; actual supplier acceptance precedes a separately written/approved status commit. No model chooses a substitute part.
tasks.previous_blocker: A similar catalogue description does not establish compatibility with the actual equipment.
tasks.enabler_now: Exact identifiers and checked specifications support native filtering and order-field reuse.
tasks.still_hard: Obsolete parts, substitutions and actual supply terms require technical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Reject an apparently matching part that has the wrong rating or mounting interface.
tasks.altitude: Less exact catalogue navigation and order copying; unchanged compatibility decisions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native procurement tools can filter exact catalogue identifiers and reuse checked fields in a reviewed supplier order.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for worker-authorised purchasing. Check actual manual catalogue and order actions; current native functions earn no new benefit. Above-limit orders retain actual purchasing escalation.

Worker produces equipment_id, model/revision, required_part_number, dimensions/ratings, quantity and needed_date in s1 at full time; manuals supply verified specification sources. Supplier produces current part lines, price, stock statement and terms. s2 retains compatibility selection/checking and unresolved data investigation; absent exact fields uses manual sourcing.

s3 fills only selected checked lines. s4 approves complete supplier, quantities, prices, total and terms before a1; substitutions or changed prices require revised final approval. s6 verifies actual response; pending order is not delivered stock.
s7 captures/checks actual status, confirmation and promised_date at full time before a2. Native controls precede code; no receipt, invoice payment or uncounted notification is performed.
research_questions: Which exact part/order fields are still copied after the current procurement tools native catalogue functions?

incremental.description: Check catalogue field and order-status mappings

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final priced order and supplier
s7 actual maintenance order status record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 6 catalogue navigation, 15 order-copy, 10 order-send and 1 status-post hours minus 1.5 upkeep = 30.5. Low halves order-copy benefit and keeps other actions manual: 7.5 minus 1.5 = 6.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Diagnose mechanical problems using tests, blueprints, manuals and parts catalogues.

steps.what: Find current equipment drawings, repair history, manuals and catalogue references in a native view
Inspect the mechanical problem and verify the actual operating and safe-work conditions
Perform the appropriate mechanical checks and interpret actual test responses
Diagnose the mechanical problem and determine a suitable corrective method
outputs: human mechanical diagnosis and correction decision

steps.what: Write and approve actual findings, diagnosis, correction decision and unresolved checks
inputs: human mechanical diagnosis and correction decision

steps.what: Commit the approved actual mechanical diagnosis record
outputs: filed mechanical diagnosis and proposed correction

tasks.design: Configure a native equipment/reference view in the maintenance system ({OTHER}) to show current manual/drawing/history references together. Keep inspection, safe-work checks, testing, diagnosis and substantive findings writing fully human. Approve the completed diagnosis record before its separate commit; no model directs a repair or changes machinery.
tasks.previous_blocker: A reference match cannot establish the actual fault or the right test.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing equipment identity links can reduce reference navigation without replacing physical diagnosis.
tasks.still_hard: Fault isolation and corrective judgement require actual equipment observations.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise that the apparent failed part is a symptom of another mechanical problem.
tasks.altitude: Less reference hunting with unchanged mechanical diagnosis.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: maintenance systems can link equipment identifiers to existing drawings, repair history and manuals without diagnosing a mechanical fault.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Establish actual cross-source lookup and record commit; existing equipment reference views earn no new benefit.

Existing equipment/document owners produce equipment_id, document_id, applicable_model, revision and current history records. s1 worker verifies identity/version and reads relevant material in retained 9 hours per provisional 100. No free re-indexing or inferred applicability; missing links use manual search.

Worker produces actual findings and correction judgement in s2/s3/s4; s5 separately captures fault observations, test/result, units where applicable, actual diagnosis, proposed correction and open questions at full time before a1. Proposed repair is not recorded as completed work.
Native reference/forms precede code. Changes revoke approval; all physical tests and diagnostic reasoning retain full time.
research_questions: Can the current maintenance system show the right current references without new technician indexing work?

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete actual diagnosis record and equipment reference

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 6 reference-navigation and 2 commit hours minus 1 upkeep = 7. Low halves navigation and keeps commit manual: 3 minus 1 = 2. Physical diagnosis unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design equipment that aids machine or building maintenance and repairs.

steps.what: Inspect the actual repair access problem, equipment interfaces and operating constraints
Capture checked interface measurements, loads, clearances and use requirements
Design the maintenance aid and reason through its mechanism, materials and limitations
Draft the aid using native CAD reuse for checked standard geometry and dimensions
Build or fit a trial aid under the actual approved workshop test arrangements
inputs: actual workshop test materials and arrangements

steps.what: Test actual fit and function and determine necessary design corrections
outputs: actual maintenance-aid trial findings and corrections

steps.what: Document corrections and approve the complete design record and trial limitations
inputs: actual maintenance-aid trial findings and corrections

steps.what: File the approved maintenance-aid design record
outputs: filed maintenance-aid design and trial record

tasks.design: Use native CAD library elements ({OTHER}) to reduce repeated geometry drafting after the worker has made the design decisions. Keep measurement capture, design reasoning, trial construction, fit/function tests and corrections human. Approve the complete actual design/trial record before filing; this records a proposal and trial, not a safety certification or production-use release.
tasks.previous_blocker: Standard geometry does not establish suitable loads, access or safe use for the actual repair.
tasks.enabler_now: Native CAD reuse can reduce drawing repetition from explicit checked dimensions.
tasks.still_hard: Mechanism choice, actual fit and design validity require practical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Design an aid that solves the real access problem without creating another maintenance hazard.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive drawing; unchanged maintenance-aid design and testing.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: CAD tools can reuse checked standard geometry while a human retains maintenance-aid design and physical validation.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Establish actual repeat geometry drafting and filing; existing CAD reuse earns no new benefit. No physical construction or trial time is reduced.

Worker produces actual interface observations and measurements in s1/s2, capturing equipment_id, dimensions, units, clearances, stated load basis and use limits at full time. Existing CAD library owner supplies checked standard elements. Unknown loads or interfaces require manual investigation/escalation, never generated design facts.

s3 retains actual design decisions; s4 retains 14 hours per provisional 100 for adapting/checking geometry and corrections. Missing library elements use manual drawing. s5/s6 actual trial findings are new evidence rather than assumed from drawings.

s7 separately records actual findings/corrections and checks the complete final record before a1; edits revoke approval. Native CAD/document features precede code. Specialist engineering review/release remains the actual separate authority where required.
research_questions: Which repeated geometry operations remain after the current CAD library supports the workers actual design?

incremental.description: Check CAD element and dimension-source mappings

approvals.approved_version: s7 complete design/trial record and source revisions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 6 repeat-drafting and 1 filing hours minus 1 upkeep = 6. Low halves drafting benefit and keeps filing manual: 3 minus 1 = 2. Design judgement and physical trials unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record the type and cost of maintenance or repair work.

steps.what: Establish the actual completed work and verify job, asset and parts evidence
inputs: existing work order and actual parts issue/cost records
outputs: worker-verified maintenance work and cost sources

steps.what: Capture actual work type, time, parts quantities and checked cost-source references
inputs: worker-verified maintenance work and cost sources

steps.what: Populate the draft maintenance record from exact checked work and cost fields
Calculate recorded work costs from actual quantities and the approved cost basis
outputs: complete candidate maintenance type and cost record

steps.what: Check and approve the complete actual work type, quantities and cost record
inputs: complete candidate maintenance type and cost record
worker-verified maintenance work and cost sources
outputs: approved final actual maintenance type and cost record

steps.what: Commit the approved final maintenance type and cost record
inputs: approved final actual maintenance type and cost record
outputs: filed actual maintenance type and cost record

tasks.design: Configure exact-field work-order import and cost calculation in the existing maintenance management system ({OTHER}), reading actual cost sources from {ERP}. Keep original work/cost verification, capture and final completeness/meaning checks explicit. Commit the completed approved record separately; this does not post an invoice or close an unresolved physical repair.
tasks.previous_blocker: A planned job or current catalogue price does not establish actual work done or actual cost.
tasks.enabler_now: Native work-order fields can reuse checked actual quantities and approved cost bases.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete parts evidence and uncertain completed work require technician checking.
tasks.human_edge: Keep a proposed correction separate from completed work and avoid attributing unrelated costs to the asset.
tasks.altitude: Less second transcription and arithmetic; unchanged factual work capture.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: maintenance systems can import checked work fields and total actual quantities using an explicit approved cost basis.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Verify actual second entry, manual cost arithmetic and commit effort; if staff already enter once and costs total natively, those benefits do not apply. Runtime earns no labour saving.

Worker produces actual job type and time; existing stores/finance owners produce actual part issues, source cost and approved labour-rate basis. s1 verifies evidence; s2 worker captures job_id, asset_id, actual_work_type, performed_work, actual_hours, part_id, quantity, unit, actual_cost_reference and approved_rate_reference at full time. No missing cost is guessed from a current catalogue.

s3 maps exact checked fields. s4 applies explicit actual quantity/rate formulas, preserving unknown cost lines for manual resolution rather than zero-filling. s5 retains meaning, completeness and cost-source checks before a1 binds the complete final record.

Native work-order/import/cost features precede code. Changed facts revoke approval. This is the type/cost record, distinct from diagnosis or purchase-status notes; identical actual actions must not be counted twice. No ERP financial posting or external send is hidden.
research_questions: Which work/cost fields are still copied or manually totalled after the current maintenance systems native close-out form?

incremental.description: Check work/cost mappings, units and approved rate sources

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete actual work type/cost record and job reference

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 20 second-entry, 15 arithmetic and 5 commit hours minus 2 upkeep = 38. Low halves second-entry benefit and keeps arithmetic/commit unchanged: 10 minus 2 = 8. Original fact capture and verification unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain physical repair and technical judgement while native records handle exact facts and approved transfers.
reach: Help planners and finance distinguish proposed work, actual completed work, supplier orders and source-qualified costs.
role.ambitious_version: A maintenance worker who keeps attention on equipment and reliable repairs while spending less time repeating checked job facts.
